description: Quote the exact Gold price to animate an owned image with motion from an owned video. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_generate_motion_transfer with the same inputs and quote_token.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio supported by the model, such as 16:9.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds, where supported by the model.

model.description: Enabled video model supporting motion-transfer; chargen_list_media_models can help choose a model. This never changes the operation.

prompt.description: Optional: a short note on what should be seen.

resolution.description: Resolution supported by the model, such as 720p.

source_image_id.description: Owned still image to animate or use as the portrait.

video_id.description: Owned gallery video UUID to edit, follow or add sound to.

name: chargen_quote_motion_transfer
title: Quote motion transfer
